children: U.S. ethanol inventories rose last week to their highest level in two months while production edged down from the week before, according to data released Wednesday by the Energy Information Administration.

Ethanol stocks were 24.9 million barrels in the week ended Nov. 13, up by 563,000 barrels from the previous week, the EIA said. Stocks were up by 2.6 million barrels from 22.3 million barrels a year earlier.
Ethanol production slipped by 4,000 barrels a day last week to 1.126 million barrels a day, but was up from 1.091 million barrels a day a year earlier.

Production estimates among analysts surveyed by Dow Jones ranged from 1.095 million barrels a day to 1.15 million barrels a day. Inventory estimates ranged from 23.5 million barrels to 24.7 million barrels.
